instructions_to_main_agent: Build a gorgeous, responsive Music School Management Web Application for Sanskritika Mirza Academy.
Implement staff login with sample credentials (staff / music2026).

Build 6 core modules: Dashboard & Analytics, Student Directory & Registration, Attendance Management, Fee & Dues Management (with second-Sunday due date & payment recording), Printable Receipt, and WhatsApp/SMS reminder link generator.
Seed 8 realistic sample student records on backend startup.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, table rows, and modals have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use warm editorial typography (Playfair Display + Plus Jakarta Sans) and organic earthy palette (#FAF7F2 background, #8B4513 primary).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts without purpose. Create asymmetric balance and generous spacing.
Always use data-testid on interactive elements.
Ensure high contrast and accessible text colors.
